kmeans_conv_chunk.note: Lloyd iterations enqueued per device-convergence flag read (IDN_KMEANS_DEVICE_CONV loop). ONE int sweep define replacing the five mutually overriding MOJOLEARN_IDN_KMEANS_CONV_CHUNK_1|_2|_4|_16|_32 (now refused by the guard); each value keeps that old arm's loop. Legal set 1|2|4|8|16|32, default 8. Cost: one host sync per chunk vs up to chunk-1 near-empty launches past convergence; no shape rule. No bit moves (labels, centroids, inertia, n_iter are the per-iteration loop's); the host column has no chunked loop, so it is unaffected. Reached by every kmeans_fit caller: classical:kmeans (_mojolearn), more:gmm kmeans init (_mojolearn_mixture), more:ivf coarse kmeans (_mojolearn_ivf). Prior evidence (source comment): A08 chunk 1 partial AMD win 0.83-0.99x, NVIDIA mixed.

ols_one_entry.note: This is the brief's MOJOLEARN_CLASSICAL_OLS_CENTER_RESIDENT idea, which is ALREADY the IDENTICAL default: idn_flags bit 0 (IDN_OLS_ONE_ENTRY, on in every IDENTICAL build) routes LinearRegression.fit (fit_intercept=True, no weights, tall design: the board's call) through _ols_tsqr_centered -> x_decomp_ols_tsqr_r -> DevExec.ols_tsqr_factor, which uploads X and y once and does column sums, means, centering and the blocked TSQR on resident buffers. The host round trip the report read at linear_model.py:715-726 is the fallback taken only when the flag is clear. No new define was added (it would duplicate this one). The grid control is the existing _OFF arm, so the A/B measures the resident route against the old four-crossing route. Same words both arms (docstring); host column (_mojolearn_x_decomp_host) follows the same flag.

ridge_ff_always.note: Existing A/B arm, now registered: chol_trusted returns False, so every Ridge solve takes the float-float route (x_linear/ff.mojo) instead of the float32 Cholesky with the 2^-12 pivot gate. Reached by expanded:ridge-clf (ridge_fit_grid ra_factor_kernel / t_ridge_solve_best) and expanded:ridge-cv (kf_solve_kernel via kf_solve, and the refit). Where the float32 factor is already untrusted (istella) it is the incumbent route; where it is trusted (taxi) it moves bits to the float-float answer on device and host column together (_ridge_fit_host and the host kf_solve read the same define), so NVIDIA and AMD still agree. Its purpose is the cost B arm for float-float work (e.g. a blocked RidgeCV float-float fallback); expected slower, quality equal or better.
